GO-2026-5932 (x/crypto openpgp unmaintained). NOT REACHABLE: warden imports only x/crypto/ssh for SSHSIG verification; x/crypto/openpgp appears 0 times in the dependency graph and govulncheck confirms "your code doesn't appear to call these". No fixed version exists — v0.54.0 is latest and the advisory is that the package is unmaintained by design, not a fixable defect. Re-evaluate if warden ever imports openpgp, or if the advisory is superseded.

Required capability, not an oversight: the provenance-main job pushes refs/notes/warden, which needs contents:write. No variant avoids it — a deploy key or PAT only relocates the credential and adds a second standing secret. Scoped as tightly as GHA allows: workflow-level permissions are {} and the write is granted on the single attest job, which never touches a branch (--attest-only).
